title: Excellent

author: marduran1928

title: Wonderful experience of a dark Barcelona
text: A very well organized and documented tour to discover a part of the dark and hidden history of our beloved Barcelona by Cristina Belenguer that leaves no one indifferent. The passion for his work is clearly reflected from minute 1. Without a doubt, this has been the first of many tours that I will do with OH MY GUIDE Barcelona and that I recommend 100 × 100!!! CONGRATULATIONS Cristina for moving forward despite the terrible pandemic that has affected the tourism sector so much and transmit so much enthusiasm at all times.
author: RAQUEL A

title: Not to be missed
text: Great route and best guide, Cristina was fantastic.  If you like mystery and Barcelona you cannot miss it… If you think you know Barcelona, ​​this route will surprise you.
author: selopez02

title: Super👌
text: It was the best decision to ask Christina for a private guide tour! In 5 ours we saw the main places of Barcelona and we also had wonderful experience in Picasso museum. This guid is very well informed about art!!! For me that was the greatest part of our tour. Also Christina told us interesting stories about artist, places and history. She advised where to eat (nice local places). That was very useful. I am glad that we have chosen this guide👍🤩
author: 793rutav

title: Many different sites and stories!
text: Crimes tour is a great way to see different neighborhoods in Barcelona! Cristina knows Barcelona well and took us to so many different places that you'd miss on a typical tour. The stories varied widely, from  historical to supernatural. With COVID, the crimes tour was a safer way to experience the city outside. The headphones and app helped a lot too! We've been on Cristina's Barcelona sweets tour and Sitges tour as well. Cristina is always fun, personable, and knowledgable. I would definitely recommend!
author: W1524IVisabelm

title: Best tours in Barcelona!
text: Cristina was amazing! I actually went on three tours with her. The crime tour, a Barcelona sweets tour, and a tour of Sitges. She was awesome and knew so much information about everything she showed us. She also gave us such an authentic experience that you wont find at larger organizations. She made sure we always felt welcome and I loved every tour I went on with her!
author: 542parkerf

title: Incredible and inspiring!
